Hello! I see you're working on your Warrior One pose—great job getting into it! Let's refine it a bit to ensure you're getting the most out of it and keeping your body safe.

First, let's focus on your spine. I see it's not quite straight. Try to engage your core a bit more, feel the length in your back, and gently tug your tailbone downward. Imagine there's a string pulling you upwards from the top of your head, helping to elongate your spine.

Next, let's address your arms. They're not reaching straight up as they should be. Bring your arms up, close to your ears, and try to reach towards the ceiling. Think about lengthening through your fingertips and keeping your shoulders relaxed at the same time.

Lastly, let's take a look at your knees. Notice how they're not directly over your ankles. Adjust your front foot position, ensuring your knee is stacked over your ankle. This will also help in maintaining balance and protecting your joints.

You're doing a great job, and with these adjustments, your Warrior One will be even stronger. Keep practicing, and remember, it's all about progress, not perfection. Well done!
